summary: Validated F0 backend, live dashboard, production build, static configuration, and scope documentation. Backend tests and frontend build pass; live health correctly reports reachable API with unavailable PostgreSQL.

ui_bugs.issue: good-status-dot and bad-status-dot data-testid values are reused across multiple rendered status indicators (2 instances each), violating the unique testability contract.
The critical user-facing Enabled status has no dedicated data-testid.

action_items: Give each status indicator a unique semantic data-testid and add a dedicated testid to request tracing status.
Run Docker Compose acceptance in an environment with Docker installed.
critical_code_review_comments: Compose uses development fallback values such as change-me-locally; keep these strictly documented placeholders and ensure deployment overrides are mandatory.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend health and alias, degraded DB behavior, live dashboard, refresh, mobile load, build, docs, and static Supabase scan were checked. Docker execution was not possible because docker is not installed.
rca of the issue: StatusDot constructs its testid solely from state, while multiple cards and the overall badge share each state; React renders duplicate selectors. The observability strong element has no data-testid in App.js.
